name: ui-kit
description: Plain React components, imported via relative paths from client-ui and admin-ui — same precedent as packages/tenant-config and packages/domain (not a workspace package yet). React is a peer, not a bundled dependency, since both consuming apps already depend on it directly. Styling comes from each app's own global.css (no CSS Modules/Tailwind in this repo); these components carry no styles of their own, only class names, so moving them here is behavior-neutral.
